instrument: Original non-diagnostic self-reflection tool; not a validated instrument

concerns.title: Stress & Pressure
concerns.insight: Your answers may help you explore how responsibilities, control and time to recover are affecting you.
concerns.suggestion: Consider identifying one demand you can reduce and one small opportunity to rest.

questions.text: I felt that daily responsibilities were piling up faster than I could manage.
I found it difficult to relax even when I had free time.
I felt pulled in too many directions at once.
Unexpected changes made my day feel harder to manage.
I felt I had little control over how I spent my time.
I kept thinking about unfinished responsibilities after my day ended.
I had difficulty making room for breaks or recovery.

concerns.title: Worry & Overthinking
concerns.insight: Your answers may point to patterns in how worry, uncertainty and repeated thinking use your attention.
concerns.suggestion: Try writing down one worry and separating actionable next steps from unknowns.

questions.text: I found myself worrying about several different things.
Once a worry started, it was difficult to set aside.
I repeatedly imagined what could go wrong in the future.
I replayed past conversations or decisions in my mind.
Uncertainty made it difficult to move forward with decisions.
I sought repeated reassurance before feeling comfortable about a decision.
Worry distracted me from things I wanted to focus on.

concerns.title: Mood & Motivation
concerns.insight: Your answers may reveal how enjoyment, energy and motivation have been showing up recently.
concerns.suggestion: Choose one small meaningful or enjoyable activity without pressuring yourself to feel a particular way.

questions.text: Activities I usually enjoy felt less interesting than normal.
I found it difficult to get started with everyday activities.
My mood felt lower than I would have liked.
Small tasks required more effort than usual.
I found it difficult to look forward to things.
I withdrew from activities I normally choose to do.
I felt less motivated to pursue things that matter to me.

concerns.title: Sleep & Rest
concerns.insight: Your answers may help you identify whether sleep and recovery deserve more attention.
concerns.suggestion: Experiment with a regular wind-down routine; consider medical advice for persistent sleep problems.

questions.text: I had difficulty falling asleep when I wanted to.
I woke during the night and struggled to return to sleep.
I woke feeling less rested than I hoped.
Tiredness made everyday activities harder.
Thoughts or concerns kept me awake at bedtime.
My sleep schedule felt difficult to keep consistent.
I felt that poor rest affected my mood or concentration.

concerns.title: Self-Esteem & Self-Talk
concerns.insight: Your answers may highlight how self-criticism, comparison and confidence influence your everyday experience.
concerns.suggestion: Notice one self-critical thought and consider a fairer, more balanced alternative.

questions.text: I criticised myself for small mistakes.
I compared myself with others in ways that left me feeling inadequate.
I had difficulty accepting positive feedback about myself.
I doubted my ability to handle challenges I would normally attempt.
I focused more on my shortcomings than my strengths.
I worried that other people would judge me negatively.
I spoke to myself more harshly than I would speak to a friend.

concerns.title: Relationships & Boundaries
concerns.insight: Your answers may highlight areas of communication, boundaries or support you want to work on.
concerns.suggestion: Consider one low-pressure conversation where you can express a specific need clearly.

questions.text: I held back from expressing what I needed in close relationships.
Unresolved disagreements stayed on my mind.
I found it difficult to say no when something felt too demanding.
I worried about disappointing people when setting boundaries.
I felt misunderstood during important conversations.
I avoided conversations because I feared conflict.
I found it hard to ask people close to me for support.

concerns.title: Emotional Balance
concerns.insight: Your answers may point to opportunities to identify emotions and respond to them with more choice.
concerns.suggestion: Try naming the emotion, noticing what triggered it and pausing before acting.

questions.text: My emotional reactions felt more intense than I expected.
It was difficult to identify exactly what I was feeling.
Strong feelings made it hard to pause before responding.
I needed a long time to settle after an upsetting event.
I kept difficult feelings to myself even when I wanted support.
I felt frustrated by how quickly my mood shifted.
I struggled to find helpful ways to manage difficult emotions.

concerns.title: Focus & Attention
concerns.insight: Your answers may show how concentration, distractions and routines are affecting everyday activities.
concerns.suggestion: Try choosing one realistic task and giving it a short distraction-reduced time block.

questions.text: I struggled to stay focused on a task I wanted to complete.
I switched between activities before finishing them.
Distractions interrupted my work or daily activities.
It was hard to organise tasks in a manageable order.
I put off tasks even when they mattered to me.
I lost track of what I was doing during routine activities.
Difficulty concentrating affected my productivity or satisfaction.

concerns.title: Loneliness & Connection
concerns.insight: Your answers may help clarify what connection and emotional support have felt like recently.
concerns.suggestion: Consider reaching out to someone you trust for a conversation or shared activity.

questions.text: I felt lonely even when other people were around.
I wished I had someone I could speak openly with.
I felt that my relationships lacked the closeness I wanted.
I hesitated to reach out to others when I needed company.
I felt disconnected from people who matter to me.
I felt left out of social plans or conversations.
I had fewer meaningful interactions than I wanted.

concerns.title: Life Satisfaction & Direction
concerns.insight: Your answers may highlight questions around meaning, priorities and everyday satisfaction.
concerns.suggestion: Identify one value that matters to you and a small action that expresses it.

questions.text: My daily routine felt disconnected from what matters most to me.
I struggled to find a sense of fulfilment in everyday life.
I felt unsure about what I wanted to prioritise.
I had difficulty making time for activities that feel meaningful.
I felt stuck in routines I would like to change.
I questioned whether my current choices reflected my personal values.
I found it hard to recognise progress toward things important to me.
